notes: Card: peaks on ' but', ' before', ' able', ' know', ' use' after must / have to / need to (the - pole takes 'or face …', the threat side). Probes: 'must be … but is' 0.22-0.52, 'have to … to' 0.31-0.46, 'before being able' 0.33-0.44; 'need to be signed in to' 0.03-0.06; no-necessity versions 0.04-0.05. Low max (8.9) and 40% echo regime.
